text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ehe... Ehehe. How was that, Brother?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ehe... Ehehe. How was that, Sister?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
choice_data_list: Yeah, that was a great run!
Yes, that was a great run!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe, yeah! Well then, for the next 
Tenno Sho (Spring) too—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
T-Today, well... I came all by myself to 
cheer for Rice-san.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Following up on your Kikuka-sho 
performance, that was wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Striving relentlessly toward a single 
goal... That figure is just like a heroine 
leading the people! It could even be told 
in books for generations to come...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Auuugh... You're praising me way too 
much...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm sorry... It was just out of 
habit...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: N-No. I'm sorry. But... thank you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It was a little embarrassing... but Rice 
was really happy.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Because I... want to become like a "Blue 
Rose of Happiness" too.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...! I've read that picture book before 
too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, supervising the two as they 
chatted excitedly about books, we made our 
way back to the academy.
